text_en: As for the divisions of the gatekeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
text_cn: 守门者的班次如下：科辣黑族中，有阿彼雅撒夫的子孙科辣黑的儿子默舍肋米雅。

text_en: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
text_cn: 默舍肋米雅的儿子：长子为则加黎雅，次为耶狄厄耳，三为则巴狄雅，四为雅特尼耳，

text_en: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Eliehoenai the seventh.
text_cn: 五为赫蓝，六为约哈南，七为厄肋约乃。

text_en: Obed-edom had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sachar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,
text_cn: 敖贝得厄东的儿子：长子为舍玛雅，次为约匝巴得，三为约阿黑，四为撒加尔，五为乃塔乃耳，

text_en: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peullethai the eighth; for God blessed him.
text_cn: 六为阿米耳，七为依撒加尔，八为培乌肋泰；天主实在祝福了敖贝得厄东。

text_en: Also to his son Shemaiah sons were born who exercised authority in their ancestral houses, for they were men of great ability.
text_cn: 他的儿子舍玛雅所生的儿子，都为他们父家的主管，因为都是有力的勇士。

text_en: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad, whose brothers were able men, Elihu and Semachiah.
text_cn: 舍玛雅的儿子：敖特尼、勒法耳和敖贝得；他的兄弟厄耳匝巴得的儿子，厄里胡和色玛革雅也是勇敢的人。

text_en: All these, sons of Obed-edom with their sons and brothers, were able men qualified for the service; sixty-two of Obed-edom.
text_cn: 这些都是敖贝得厄东的后裔。他们及他们的儿子并兄弟，个个都是勇敢而又能干的人。敖贝得厄东的后裔共计六十二人。

text_en: Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, able men, eighteen.
text_cn: 默舍肋米雅的子孙和弟兄，都是勇士，共计十八人。

text_en: Hosah, of the sons of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief (for though he was not the firstborn, his father made him chief),
text_cn: 默辣黎的子孙中曷撒有些儿子：为首的是史默黎，他原非长子，是他父亲立他为首的，

text_en: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons and brothers of Hosah totaled thirteen.
text_cn: 次为希耳克雅，三为特巴里雅，四为则加黎雅。曷撒的儿子和弟兄共计十三人。

text_en: These divisions of the gatekeepers, corresponding to their leaders, had duties, just as their kindred did, ministering in the house of the Lord ;
text_cn: 以上是守门者的班次，无论是族长或是他们的弟兄，在上主殿内尽职，都有同等的任务。

text_en: and they cast lots by ancestral houses, small and great alike, for their gates.
text_cn: 他们不论大小，按照他们的家族抽签，看守各门。

text_en: The lot for the east fell to Shelemiah. They cast lots also for his son Zechariah, a prudent counselor, and his lot came out for the north.
text_cn: 中签守东门的为舍肋米雅。他的儿子则加黎雅是个聪敏的谋士，中签守北门。

text_en: Obed-edom’s came out for the south, and to his sons was allotted the storehouse.
text_cn: 敖贝得厄东守卫南门，他的儿子们看守库房。

text_en: For Shuppim and Hosah it came out for the west, at the gate of Shallecheth on the ascending road. Guard corresponded to guard.
text_cn: 曷撒守西边上坡大路的舍肋革特门。每班守卫人数相等：

text_en: On the east there were six Levites each day, on the north four each day, on the south four each day, as well as two and two at the storehouse;
text_cn: 东面每日六人，北面每日四人，南面每日四人，每一库房二人；

text_en: and for the colonnade on the west there were four at the road and two at the colonnade.
text_cn: 西面廊房行人路上四人，廊房两人：

text_en: These were the divisions of the gatekeepers among the Korahites and the sons of Merari.
text_cn: 以上是科辣黑子孙和默辣黎子孙守门的班次。

text_en: And of the Levites, Ahijah had charge of the treasuries of the house of God and the treasuries of the dedicated gifts.
text_cn: 他们的弟兄肋未人，掌管天主殿内的府库，及圣物的府库。

text_en: The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, the heads of families belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli.
text_cn: 革尔雄族拉当的子孙中作族长的，是革尔雄族拉当的子孙耶希耳。

text_en: The sons of Jehieli, Zetham and his brother Joel, were in charge of the treasuries of the house of the Lord .
text_cn: 耶希耳与他的兄弟则堂和约厄耳掌管上主殿内的府库。

text_en: Of the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites:
text_cn: 至于阿默兰族、依兹哈尔族、赫贝龙族和乌齐耳族：

text_en: Shebuel son of Gershom, son of Moses, was chief officer in charge of the treasuries.
text_cn: 有梅瑟的儿子，革尔雄的子孙叔巴耳为府库的司长。

text_en: His brothers: from Eliezer were his son Rehabiah, his son Jeshaiah, his son Joram, his son Zichri, and his son Shelomoth.
text_cn: 至于他的弟兄厄里厄则尔的子孙，是勒哈彼雅、耶沙雅、约兰、齐革黎和舍罗米特。

text_en: This Shelomoth and his brothers were in charge of all the treasuries of the dedicated gifts that King David, and the heads of families, and the officers of the thousands and the hundreds, and the commanders of the army, had dedicated.
text_cn: 这舍罗米特和他的弟兄们掌管府库中的一切圣物，就是达味君王、各族长、千夫长、百夫长及军官所献的圣物；

text_en: From booty won in battles they dedicated gifts for the maintenance of the house of the Lord .
text_cn: 他们将战争时所掠获的财物献上，作为修建上主殿宇之用。

text_en: Also all that Samuel the seer, and Saul son of Kish, and Abner son of Ner, and Joab son of Zeruiah had dedicated—all dedicated gifts were in the care of Shelomoth and his brothers.
text_cn: 此外，尚有“先见者”撒慕尔、克士的儿子撒乌耳、乃尔的儿子阿贝乃尔和责鲁雅的儿子约阿布所献的一切财物。总之，凡是奉献之物，全由舍罗米特和他的弟兄们掌管。

text_en: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were appointed to outside duties for Israel, as officers and judges.
text_cn: 依兹哈尔的子孙革纳尼雅和他的儿子充任官长和判官，处理以色列的外务。

text_en: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brothers, one thousand seven hundred men of ability, had the oversight of Israel west of the Jordan for all the work of the Lord and for the service of the king.
text_cn: 赫贝龙的子孙哈沙彼雅和他的弟兄一千七百人，都是勇敢的人，负责约但河西以色列人所有关于上主和君王的事务。

text_en: Of the Hebronites, Jerijah was chief of the Hebronites. (In the fortieth year of David’s reign search was made, of whatever genealogy or family, and men of great ability among them were found at Jazer in Gilead. )
text_cn: 赫贝龙族为族长的是耶黎雅。达味在位第四十年，曾按照赫贝龙族的族系和家世调查，在基肋阿得的雅则尔找到了这族的有力的勇士。

text_en: King David appointed him and his brothers, two thousand seven hundred men of ability, heads of families, to have the oversight of the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of the Manassites for everything pertaining to God and for the affairs of the king.
text_cn: 耶黎雅的弟兄中二千七百人，都是英勇之士又兼为族长；达味君王便委派他们负责勒乌本人、加得人和默纳协半支派的一切有关天主和君王的事务。
